description: Allowlist for accepted dependency security advisories. Each entry requires: id (GHSA or CVE identifier), package (affected package name), reason (human-readable justification for acceptance), and reviewDate (ISO 8601 date by which the acceptance must be re-reviewed).

id.description: Advisory identifier, e.g. GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx or CVE-YYYY-NNNNN

reason.description: Human-readable justification for accepting the advisory

reviewDate.description: ISO 8601 date by which this acceptance must be re-reviewed
